summary: Iteration 11 — CMS-driven Home Page + bottom-tabs restructure. All 7 review checklists PASS end-to-end on the web preview (390x844) with only ONE medium bug and one minor seed-data issue found. GUEST /: index → /(tabs)/home, splash 'home-splash' fades within ~2s, header shows home-menu + logo + home-notifications-bell, home-slider1 renders with 4 dot children in home-slider1-dots and its srcs hit /api/files/home/sl1-1.png etc. All sections mount lazily via FlatList (initialNumToRender=3, windowSize=3) as the container is scrolled — home-pricing (home-base-price = ₹2,124), home-steps + home-step-1..5, home-why with 3 video cards video-{id} (tapping video-play-{id} opens modal with YouTube iframe present; video-close removes iframe), home-slider2 with 3 dots, home-privacy → home-privacy-link → /policy/privacy loads real privacy text ('ClickBook ("we"…)'), home-login2, home-slider3 with 3 dots, home-final-hero, home-login3, home-footer with footer-faq/privacy/terms/refund/shipping — footer-faq → /policy/faq contains 'What is ClickBook?'. No horizontal page scroll (dw==cw==390). GUEST inline login: 5-digit input + home-login1-continue → home-login1-error 'Enter your 10-digit mobile number'; 10-digit 9876500777 → /verify screen with devHint in the URL and shown inline; typing OTP into verify-otp-input + tap 'Verify & Continue' (testID verify-otp-button) lands on /home now signed-in — home-login1-start button rendered instead of the mobile input. GUEST tab guard: Chat / Orders / Profile bottom-tabs all redirect to /login when logged out (verified for Chat). SIGNED-IN: 6 home-draft-* cards render, home-see-all-albums present, home-notifications-bell → /notifications, Chat tab → /chat, Orders → /orders, Profile → /profile, profile-my-books testID present, LEGAL list contains FAQ (testID profile-policy-faq, not profile-legal-faq). Hamburger opens SideMenu — menu-faq / menu-refund-cancellation (→ /policy/refund) / menu-shipping-delivery / menu-terms-conditions / menu-home / menu-close all present and work. ADMIN CMS: /admin/login with admin/clickbook@2026 lands /admin/dashboard, admin-nav-home → /admin/home. Slider 1 tab exposes 4 admin-slide-{id} rows with title/replace/delete/active testIDs. Edited slide 2 title → 'QA Title' and toggled slide 3 admin-slide-active-{id} OFF, tapped admin-home-save → admin-home-msg 'Saved — live in the app now ✓'. GET /api/home immediately after save confirmed slider1 now returns 3 active slides with the middle one titled 'QA Title'. Then RESTORE: cleared title + re-enabled slide 3 + save → GET /api/home is back to 4 active untitled slides. admin-home-tab-videos exposes 3 videos, admin-home-tab-heroes exposes 4 heroes (pricing/steps/privacy/final). Regression: /album/09fdba…/editor loads with 5 tool tabs (editor-tool-background/layout/pages/photos/text); /create/upload?albumId=09fdba… loads upload-photo-grid with 119 photos. Backend GET /api/home returns full CMS payload with pricing.base_price=2124. Bell on GUEST → /login; on SIGNED-IN → /notifications. BUG (medium) found: After OTP verification, /verify calls router.replace('/(tabs)/home') and the customer Home tree gets mounted TWICE (duplicate testIDs for home-menu, home-notifications-bell, home-sections, home-slider1, home-slider1-dots, home-login1, home-pricing, home-base-price, home-steps, home-step-1..5, slide-*). Only the top instance is visually rendered but both live in the DOM, breaking strict-mode locators and doubling render work / react-query subscriptions. Reproducible ONLY on the login→verify→home path. Direct-load /home with a token in localStorage renders a single tree with NO duplicates (verified). Guest /home also renders a single tree. RCA: the initial Index redirect () mounts /(tabs)/home once; verify.tsx then router.replace('/(tabs)/home') and Expo Router on RN-Web stacks a second instance instead of replacing when the target belongs to the same segment already present in the history. Suggested fix: replace with router.dismissAll()+replace, or navigate to a canonical path like router.replace('/home'), or use router.push then router.dismissAll on the tabs layout mount. Minor: the first seed video in home-why (video-play-6614cca8cb9a4c54a1bb489b1cbb92a8) opens the modal but the embedded YouTube iframe returns 'Video unavailable — This content isn\'t available' (content-side error, not app-side). Update seed home videos with valid public YouTube IDs. The other slots load correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer OTP verify hint is exposed on /verify?...&devHint=<6-digit>. Bypass the UI verify flow by calling POST /api/auth/otp/send + POST /api/auth/otp/verify with dev_hint to grab a token, then setItem('clickbook.customerToken', token) and goto('/home') — this avoids the post-verify duplicate-Home-mount bug so subsequent locator-based tests do not hit strict-mode failures. Admin token key = clickbook.adminToken. Admin/home slide edit uses testIDs admin-slide-title-{id} / admin-slide-active-{id} / admin-home-save / admin-home-msg. Save button reads 'Save & publish' visually.
rca_of_issue: Duplicate Home mount bug — When the index route renders <Redirect href='/(tabs)/home' /> the tabs layout + home screen mount once. On sign-in from /verify, router.replace('/(tabs)/home') fires while the tabs stack is already mounted; on RN-Web the router keeps the previous instance mounted instead of unmounting, so two copies of the tabs/home subtree live in the DOM concurrently. Reproduction: (1) fresh localStorage, load /, (2) type 9876500777 + Continue, (3) type devHint + Verify & Continue, (4) inspect document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="home-menu"]').length → 2. Direct load of /home with a valid token in localStorage produces length===1. Suggested mitigation: replace with a plain string path ('/home') or call router.dismissAll() prior to router.replace in verify.tsx, and additionally guard index.tsx to only redirect for guests (skip redirect when a token already exists so the router doesn't stack the tabs group twice on sign-in transitions).
